subject: Hospitality
title: Underwater Hotels
description: A quick, practical guide to Underwater Hotels.

hook.text: The Muraka at Conrad Maldives puts your bedroom 5 meters underwater. You fall asleep watching fish swim past your ceiling.

buildup.text: Underwater suites cost $50,000+ per night. The engineering required—pressure, waterproofing, emergency systems—is extreme.

discovery.text: Only a handful exist worldwide. Each is a feat of marine engineering married to luxury hospitality design.

twist.text: Underwater hotels face sustainability scrutiny. Construction can damage coral reefs—the very beauty they sell.

climax.text: The best projects now combine underwater hospitality with marine conservation—guests fund reef restoration through their stay.

punchline.text: Sleep under the sea, save the reef above. Luxury and conservation can coexist.

quiz.question: What is a major environmental concern about underwater hotels?
options: Construction can damage coral reefs they depend on for beauty
